evidence.title: GitHub - woustachemax/glitchcn-ui: TL;DR, trying to build a UI library for Shadcn components with 'hacker' like aesthetics · GitHub

name: Glitchcn/ui
summary: Cyberpunk, terminal-styled React component library for Next.js with scanlines, glow borders and 5 themes.
description: A shadcn/ui-compatible component library with a retro-futuristic terminal aesthetic: 19 drop-in React components for Next.js, animated scanline effects, glowing themeable borders, monospace typography, clipped corner styling, dark and light modes and 5 selectable color themes. Components are installed through the shadcn CLI from its registry.
contains: 5 selectable color themes with dark and light modes
animated scanline effects and glowing borders
installed with the shadcn CLI from its registry
